services.subject: online store
services.value: The Bag Drop is an online store for demo and pre-owned golf gear at thebagdrop.co.za: demo heads, pre-owned clubs, putters, shafts and the essentials (balls, gloves, grips, towels). National shipping. No shop to visit.
services.source: BRAND-BIBLE.md section 1 (workbook A, live store 2026-10-13); store identity confirmed by Christelle 2026-10-21

services.subject: returns
services.value: Returns within 30 days of receiving the item, unused and in the condition received, after emailing hello@thebagdrop.co.za. Return shipping is paid by the customer unless the item is faulty, damaged or incorrect.
services.source: BRAND-BIBLE.md section 7 Proof bank (refund policy, read 2026-10-13)
